free_text: The decision is to defer biopsy because the panel protocol, driven by the cohort criterion (PI-RADS <= 3), strongly supports this approach, matching the reading urologist in 16 of 18 similar cases. Although the PSA trend was rising, the PI-RADS 3 score and the prior negative biopsy result weigh against immediate intervention. The evidence converged on deferral, as the retrieved data did not provide a specific finding to overturn this established protocol.
